Printable version

Otter Bay terminal is located on the northwest side of Pender Island. Pender Island is one of the Southern Gulf Islands on BC’s south coast. Sailings departing from Otter Bay provide service to Galiano, Mayne, Salt Spring, Saturna, Vancouver (Tsawwassen) and Victoria (Swartz Bay).

Check-in times

For travel to Vancouver (Tsawwassen) with a booking – Arrive at the terminal 30 to 60 minutes prior to the scheduled departure. Your booking will not be honoured and travel will be based on your order of arrival at the terminal if you arrive before booking check-in has opened, or after booking check-in has closed.

  • Booking check-in opens 60 minutes prior to the scheduled departure for foot passengers and vehicles.
  • Booking check-in closes 30 minutes prior to the scheduled departure for foot passengers and vehicles.

For travel without a booking or on a non-bookable route – Travel is based on your order of arrival at the terminal.

  • Ticket sales and check-in for foot passengers close 5 minutes prior to the scheduled sailing departure.
  • Ticket sales and check-in for vehicles close 3 minutes prior to the scheduled sailing departure.

Note: Schedules subject to change without notice.

Last updated:  Nov 20, 2026.

Departures and arrivals
Calculate fare

Non-Stop

This is a direct sailing. The ferry will not stop at any other terminals while sailing to its destination.

Stops

The ferry will stop at the terminal(s) listed and you will stay on board.

Transfers

You will disembark at the transfer terminal and board another ferry for the next leg of your trip. Connections are not guaranteed at the transfer terminal.

Thru fares between Vancouver (Tsawwassen) and Southern Gulf Islands

Let the ticket agent know at your first departure terminal that you are travelling thru fare. They will give you a voucher, which you will give to the Victoria (Swartz Bay) ticket agent when you arrive at the ticket booth. Connections are not guaranteed when you transfer at Victoria (Swartz Bay). View full details about thru fares
